title: Single-epoch W4 excess and radio-quiet background galaxy ambiguity
what_happened: Three independent review rounds confirmed the ~56-60x 22um WISE excess for Gaia DR3 4582145718700356096 from raw archive photometry, while identifying that radio_counterpart passing does not exclude the >90% radio-quiet dusty galaxy population without deep sub-arcsec optical/NIR imaging.
generic_lesson: Passing radio_counterpart never moves background_galaxy out of untested when deep_imaging is not_evaluated; single-epoch W4 candidates missing deep imaging or second-instrument 22um data must remain capped at Tier C.
